L4@P0: CABINET RESOLUTION NO. (122) OF 2024 REGARDING THE IMPLEMENTING REGULATIONS
L5@P0: OF FEDERAL LAW NO. (11) OF 2023 ON PROCUREMENT IN THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT
L6@P0: The Cabinet,
L7@P0: - Upon review of the Constitution;
L8@P0: - Federal Law No. (1) of 1972 on the competencies of ministries and ministers’ powers, and its
L9@P0: amendments;
L10@P0: - Federal Law-by-Decree No. (26) of 2019 regarding public finance, and its amendments;
L11@P0: - Federal Law No. (11) of 2023 regarding procurement in the Federal Government; and
L12@P0: - Based on the proposal of the Minister of Finance, and the approval of the Cabinet
L13@P0: Resolved as follows:
L14@P0: ARTICLE (1)
L15@P0: DEFINITIONS
L16@P0: The definitions set out in Federal Law No. (11) of 2023 referred to above, shall apply to this Resolution. In
L17@P0: addition, the following words and expressions shall have the meanings shown next to them, unless the
L18@P0: context requires otherwise:
L19@P0: Law: Federal Law No. (11) of 2023 on procurement in the Federal
L20@P0: Government.
L21@P0: Concerned Federal Entity: The Federal Entity subject to the provisions of the Law.
L22@P0: Head of the Federal Entity: The Minister or the Head of the Federal Entity or the Chairman of the
L23@P0: Board of Directors or their equivalent, as the case may be.
L24@P0: Business Day: The official working day in the UAE.
L25@P0: Digital Procurement
L26@P0: Platform:
L27@P0: The electronic procurement platform established within the Ministry.
L28@P0: Central Procurement Unit: The organizational unit within the Ministry responsible for managing the
L29@P0: Government procurement, including Government procurement policies,
L30@P0: procedures, systems, activities and documents.
L31@P0: Procurement
L32@P0: Organizational Unit:
L33@P0: The organizational unit within each Federal Entity responsible for
L34@P0: procurement roles and responsibilities and for implementing
L35@P0: procurement procedures within the Concerned Federal Entity.
L36@P0: Requesting Organizational
L37@P0: Unit:
L38@P0: The organizational unit within the Federal Entity that submits the
L39@P0: purchase request through the Procurement System to obtain the
L40@P0: necessary Purchases that meet its needs.
L41@P0: Grievance Committee: The committee formed within the Federal Entity to look into grievances
L42@P0: submitted by Suppliers against its issued decisions, in accordance with
L43@P0: the provisions of this Resolution.
L44@P0: Procurement Committee: The committee formed within the Federal Entity to exercise the roles
L45@P0: related to Procurement Processes, in accordance with the provisions of
L46@P0: this Resolution.
L47@P0: Contract Administrator: The employee of the contracting Federal Entity, authorized to act on its
L48@P0: behalf in dealing with the Supplier and to represent it in all matters
L49@P0-1: related to the contract. UNITED ARAB EMIRATES

L52@P1: Cabinet Resolution No. (122) of 2024 regarding the Implementing Regulations of Federal Law No. (11) of 2023 on Procurement in the Federal Government
L53@P1: Sourcing Strategy: A document prepared by the Procurement Organizational Unit for
L54@P1: specific Procurement Processes, outlining Procurement Methods,
L55@P1: timelines, evaluation criteria, and risks (if any) for the Procurement
L56@P1: Opportunity, in coordination with the relevant units.
L57@P1: Procurement Opportunity: Any Tender, bid, Auction, or Purchase Request issued by Federal Entities
L58@P1: in accordance with the provisions of the Law and this Resolution.
L59@P1: Tender Documents: All documents and materials related to the Procurement Process,
L60@P1: including the Tender Announcement, Request for Information (RFI),
L61@P1: Request for Quotations (RFQ), Request for Proposals (RFP), prequalification request, Supplier instructions, general and special
L62@P1: conditions, Purchases specifications and requirements, evaluation and
L63@P1: acceptance criteria, and any other documents related to the
L64@P1: Procurement Process as determined by the procuring Federal Entity.
L65@P1: Request for Proposals
L66@P1: (RFP):
L67@P1: An invitation to Suppliers to submit technical and financial proposals
L68@P1: according to the requirements of the Federal Entity within the
L69@P1: Procurement Opportunity's scope as outlined in the Tender Documents.
L70@P1: Supplier Pre-qualification: The process of conducting a preliminary evaluation of a Supplier's ability
L71@P1: to execute the required Purchases according to the pre-qualification
L72@P1: criteria and requirements set by the procuring Federal Entity. This
L73@P1: includes information on the Supplier's financial solvency, previous
L74@P1: experience, service provider resumes, and other documents specified in
L75@P1: the Pre-Qualification Document, granting the opportunity to eligible
L76@P1: Registered and Accepted Suppliers only to submit their offers to Limited
L77@P1: Tenders for said Purchases.
L78@P1: Request for Prequalification Documents
L79@P1: (RFPQ):
L80@P1: The documents requested by the procuring Federal Entity from the
L81@P1: Supplier during the pre-qualification process for any Procurement
L82@P1: Opportunity the procuring Federal Entity intends to issue by way of a
L83@P1: Limited Tender.
L84@P1: Supplier Registration: The process of Suppliers identification in the Procurement System,
L85@P1: undertaken by Suppliers wishing to participate in the Procurement
L86@P1: Opportunities of Federal Entities, in accordance with the terms and
L87@P1: conditions set by the Ministry or Federal Entity.
L88@P1: Supplier Registry: The electronic database of Registered and Accepted Suppliers in the
L89@P1: Procurement System, in accordance with the provisions of the Law, this
L90@P1: Resolution, and the Federal Government’s Procurement Procedures
L91@P1: Manual.
L92@P1: Supplier Acceptance: The process by which a Supplier is classified as an accepted and active
L93@P1: Supplier, and which is a prerequisite for participating in Procurement
L94@P1: Opportunities on the Procurement System.
L95@P1: Registered and Accepted
L96@P1: Supplier:
L97@P1: A Supplier registered in the Supplier Registry who has successfully
L98@P1: completed the registration and acceptance process on the Procurement
L99@P1: System and whose registration has been activated as a Registered and
L100@P1: Accepted Supplier by way of a notification sent to them in confirmation
L101@P1: of the same.
L102@P1: Shortlisted Supplier: A Registered and Approved Supplier participating in a Procurement
L103@P1: Opportunity, selected from a group of participating suppliers based on
L104@P1-2: specific shortlisting criteria, in anticipation of completing the UNITED ARAB EMIRATES

L109@P2: Procurement Opportunity.
L110@P2: Awarded Supplier: A Registered and Accepted Supplier participating in a Procurement
L111@P2: Opportunity who has been awarded the Procurement Opportunity and
L112@P2: notified by an Award Decision but has not yet signed the contract.
L113@P2: Contracted Supplier: A Registered and Accepted Supplier that a Federal Entity contracted with
L114@P2: through a Procurement Contract or Purchase Order, for Purchases
L115@P2: subject to the Law and this Resolution, and having met all contracting
L116@P2: requirements as necessary.
L117@P2: Award Decision: A decision made by the procuring Federal Entity in accordance with the
L118@P2: Delegation of Authority Matrix to award the Awarded Supplier,
L119@P2: informing him of the acceptance of his submitted offer and specifying
L120@P2: any additional documents or requirements necessary to complete the
L121@P2: contracting process for that Procurement Opportunity.
L122@P2: Exclusion Decision: A decision made by the Federal Entity, in accordance with the Delegation
L123@P2: of Authority Matrix, to exclude a Participating Supplier from the Tender,
L124@P2: based on any of the Supplier exclusion reasons.
L125@P2: Performance Bond: A guarantee issued on behalf of the Supplier by a bank or financial
L126@P2: institution operating within or outside the UAE in favor of the Federal
L127@P2: Entity, guaranteeing the fulfillment of Supplier's contractual obligations,
L128@P2: provided that the guarantee is in favor of the contracting Federal Entity,
L129@P2: is unconditional and valid for the entire contract period and up to ninety
L130@P2: (90) days from the end of the contract.
L131@P2: Scope of Work: The details of the technical and implementation requirements for the
L132@P2: Purchases requested from the Supplier for execution of the Procurement
L133@P2: Opportunity, including all necessary details to define the Purchases’
L134@P2: type, quantity, method, and required execution timeline clearly.
L135@P2: Tender Evaluation Criteria: The specific criteria for evaluating and comparing offers submitted by
L136@P2: Registered and Accepted Suppliers participating in a Procurement
L137@P2: Opportunity as determined by the procuring Federal Entity.
L138@P2: Purchase Order: An official document used to purchase from Registered and Accepted
L139@P2: Suppliers within a Blanket Agreement or Catalogue or for Low-Value
L140@P2: Purchases, or based on a Tender of Request for Proposals issued by the
L141@P2: procuring Federal Entity requesting the Purchases through the
L142@P2: Procurement System, specifying the Purchases’ type, quantity, method,
L143@P2: and required execution timeline clearly and without ambiguity.
L144@P2: Procurement Contract: An agreement concluded between the Awarded Supplier and the
L145@P2: procuring Federal Entity, which defines the terms and conditions specific
L146@P2: to the Purchases subject of the contract.
L147@P2: Standard Procurement
L148@P2: Contracts:
L149@P2: Unified Procurement Contract templates approved by the Ministry for
L150@P2: use by Federal Entities when contracting for Purchases, excluding
L151@P2: contracts requiring special drafting by the entity due to the complexity
L152@P2: of the Purchases.
L153@P2: Subcontracting: An agreement between the Supplier contracted with the Federal Entity
L154@P2-3: and a third party to perform part of the supply, activities or services UNITED ARAB EMIRATES

L160@P3: Supplier Alliances: An agreement between two or more Registered and Accepted Suppliers
L161@P3: to provide specific Purchases for a defined Procurement Opportunity for
L162@P3: the procuring Federal Entity, allocating responsibilities and obligations
L163@P3: among the Registered and Accepted Suppliers, who shall be jointly liable
L164@P3: for fulfilling all contractual obligations towards the procuring Federal
L165@P3: Entity.
L166@P3: Credit Note: A financial document issued by the Supplier to the contracting Federal
L167@P3: Entity to document a return of Purchases or to reduce the amount owed
L168@P3: by the Federal Entity to the Supplier based on a previous invoice predating the Credit Note.
L169@P3: Limited Tender: A tender in which a Procurement Opportunity is published to a limited
L170@P3: number of Registered and Accepted Suppliers to submit their proposals,
L171@P3: and who have successfully passed the registration and pre-qualification
L172@P3: process for the Procurement Opportunity.
L173@P3: Direct Order: An exceptional procurement method supported with the necessary
L174@P3: justifications, by which the Federal Entity contracts directly with a
L175@P3: Supplier from among the Registered and Accepted Suppliers available in
L176@P3: the market.
L177@P3: Sole Source: An exceptional procurement method supported with the necessary
L178@P3: justifications, by which the Federal Entity contracts directly with the
L179@P3: Qualified Supplier for specific Purchases due to the absence of other
L180@P3: Qualified Suppliers in the market for such Purchases.
L181@P3: Blanket Agreement: A framework agreement entered into by the Federal Entity with the
L182@P3: Awarded Supplier to fix Purchases’ prices for a specific period, in
L183@P3: accordance with the provisions of this Resolution and the Federal
L184@P3: Government Procurement Manual and Procedures.
L185@P3: Catalogue: A procurement method that includes a unified list of Purchases and
L186@P3: clarifies the unit price of those Purchases or Purchase items provided by
L187@P3: each Supplier, and their fixed prices. The Federal Entity makes its
L188@P3: purchase therefrom by way of a Purchase Order through the Federal
L189@P3: Procurement Catalogue or Local Catalogue.
L190@P3: Federal Procurement
L191@P3: Catalogue:
L192@P3: A unified list of Purchase items required by the Government that fall
L193@P3: under specific Purchase categories within the Catalogue, and that shows
L194@P3: the unit price of those Purchases or Purchase items that are agreed upon
L195@P3: by the Central Procurement Unit and the Registered and Accepted
L196@P3: Suppliers, which includes the Purchases offered by each Registered and
L197@P3: Accepted Supplier and their fixed prices, from which the Federal Entity
L198@P3: makes its purchase through a Purchase Order.
L199@P3: Local Catalogue: A unified list of Purchase items required by a single Federal Entity which
L200@P3: is agreed upon by the Purchasing Organizational Unit and the Registered
L201@P3: and Accepted Suppliers, including a specific Purchase category specific
L202@P3: to the requirements of that Federal Entity, and indicating the unit price
L203@P3: of those Purchases or Procurement categories as agreed.
L204@P3: Technical Competition: A procedure for the evaluation of Registered and Accepted Suppliers in
L205@P3-4: the Catalogue, to verify the added value they provide to the procuring UNITED ARAB EMIRATES
